handoff: Merge step approved: AC1-AC8 are each traced to a test that asserts them, and AC9's docs are in place for agent QA. Tests and typecheck are green, golden cases unchanged. One minor note: story edit needs --force at the merge step (slice 06).

findings.title: Moving a story off the merge step with story edit needs --force
findings.detail:
User story 21 says 'I merge the PR, or move the story with the usual commands'. A merge park is mid-round (roundFinished unchanged), so `norn story edit --workflow` at the merge step is refused without --force; the refusal names the forced command. This is a recorded decision in the handoff Notes, and the story edit refusal is slice 06's scope, so it is not rework here.
Axis: spec
Suggestion: Slice 06 (story edit refusal) or the person decides whether a merge park counts as a finished round for story edit and decide's roundStart.
